title: A comet lander bounced twice before coming to rest
body: On 12 November 2014 the European Space Agency's Philae probe reached comet 67P. Its anchoring system failed to secure it at first contact, and the probe touched down three times before settling.
takeaway: With so little gravity, an ordinary bounce can send a lander far from its first landing site.
source: European Space Agency, Three Touchdowns for Rosetta's Lander (2014)
visual: a small lander floating just above the rough dark surface of a comet

title: A small star called TRAPPIST-1 has seven Earth-sized planets
body: Observations announced in 2017 showed seven planets around the cool dwarf star TRAPPIST-1. Three orbit in the range where a rocky planet could have liquid water on its surface under suitable conditions.
takeaway: A planet's distance from its own star matters more for potential warmth than how close that orbit looks compared with Earth's.
source: NASA Science, NASA Telescope Reveals Earth-Size Planets Around Single Star (2017)
visual: a compact family of small rocky planets around a dim red star
